training_scope: full fine-tuning (train_vlm): vision encoder, connector, language model and all 16 action expert layers; LeRobot still freezes the last VLM layer, its final norm and lm_head, which get no gradient
schedule_source: experiment 3's continuation schedule (lr 5e-5 for all trained parameters, warmup 200, cosine to 2.5e-6, 5000 steps) from experiment 4's best (fresh optimizer); effective batch 64 = 16 x 4 accumulation on an RTX 4090 24 GB
data_scope: experiment 5: experiment 4's data, split and sampling plus trim_static_head (only the last 5 of the leading frames within 2 deg of the first state are sampled, so the start pose is no longer labelled 'wait'); normalization stats reused from runs/so101_pilot_v2/stats.json; validation frames start after the cut, so step 0 is experiment 4's best on the new validation rows
